## About Me

I am an Associate Professor of Political Science (pre-tenure) at [Hunter College, CUNY](https://www.hunter.cuny.edu/){target="_blank"}. Prior to this, I was an Assistant Professor at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.

I earned my Ph.D. (2020) and M.A. (2017) in Political Science from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, focusing on American politics and political methodology. 

I study race, ethnicity, and politics, public opinion, and policing. My book [*Destabilized: Why White Americans Accept Racist Political Rhetoric*](https://www.cambridge.org/us/universitypress/subjects/politics-international-relations/american-government-politics-and-policy/destabilized-why-white-americans-accept-racist-political-rhetoric?format=PB&isbn=9781009837392){target="_blank"} is out now with Cambridge University Press. For more information about my research and teaching interests, please click on the links above. You can also find my profile on [Women Also Know Stuff](https://www.womenalsoknowstuff.com/){target="_blank"} at [this link](https://womenalsoknowstuff.com/profile/4501){target="_blank"}. Thanks for visiting!
